resources.string: Enter the public HTTPS address of your existing BOLT12 Pay web app. The companion receives BOLT11/BOLT12 links and Amethyst\'s BIP321 handoff and opens them there for review.
Enter an HTTPS address without a path, credentials, query, or fragment.
A Lightning link is waiting. Saving will only open the payment form.
Payments are never automatic. BOLT12 Pay first shows the destination and amount in the existing web payment form.
Accepted inputs are lightning: links containing a BOLT11 invoice or BOLT12 offer and Amethyst\'s bitcoin:?lno=… handoff. Lightning addresses, LNURL, and Bitcoin-only payments are not forwarded.
No browser was found for the secure handoff to the BOLT12 Pay web app.
